readonly.query: SELECT id,status,process_type,process_instance_id,controlled_time,effective_date,activated_time,distributed_time FROM dcc_controlled_file WHERE tenant_id=1 AND id IN (2054545668044084026,2054545668044084032,2054545668044084033) ORDER BY id;
